description: Added `smithy_http.transports` and `smithy_http.aio.transports`, which let generated clients create their transport by name (`"urllib3"` for sync clients, `"aiohttp"` or `"crt"` for async clients) and apply `http` settings: `connect_timeout`, `read_timeout` and `crt.read_buffer_size`. A timeout of None disables it. Unknown settings, invalid values and `crt` settings for another transport are rejected. `AIOHTTPClientConfig` and `AWSCRTHTTPClientConfig` take a `connect_timeout`.
